## About
Skycrest Auto Service is a general repair shop on Drew Street in Clearwater. Each technician has his own area of specialty, so whether it's brakes, air conditioning, wiring or a transmission, your car goes to someone who knows that system.
We work on all brands, foreign and domestic, from older cars to new ones. Estimates are free, and if your check engine light comes on, we'll scan and read the trouble code for you for free.
We're also an official Intoxalock location. Reviewers mention Kim and the mechanics being fair and honest, and showing customers the problem on their own car before doing the work.

## Services
- Intoxalock location: Installation, removal, repairs and calibration of Intoxalock devices.
- Electronic engine analyzing: When a warning light comes on, we scan it, diagnose it and repair it.
- Complete maintenance service: Oil changes, transmission service, radiator flush, filters and more.
- Car safety inspections and tire rotation: Safety inspections, tire rotation and filters as part of regular upkeep.
- Heating and air conditioning: Heater, blower, compressor and condenser work, plus refrigerant recharge.
- Steering and suspension: Power steering, struts, shock absorbers, control arms and ball joints.
- Transmission and drivetrain: Transmission fluid changes, driveshafts, CV axles and clutch jobs.
- Electrical repair: Wiring, lighting, sensors and other electrical problems.
- Power windows: One reviewer had an old truck's power window replaced quickly.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on my kind of car?
A: Yes. We repair foreign and domestic cars, old or new.

Q: Can you tow my car to the shop?
A: Towing is arranged through Nationwide Towing or Kotakis Towing. Give us a call and we'll point you to them.

Q: Is the shop open over lunch?
A: On weekdays we take a lunch break starting at noon, so plan your drop-off or pickup around it.
